title: Observing plan v1
description: A night of observing, portable between observers. It carries the site, the night and the darkness window it was built for, not just a list of targets, so that any reader can recompute every time for their own sky instead of trusting the author's. Produced and consumed by Roque Nights (export_plan / import_plan); anyone may implement it.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Optional, but writing it makes the document self describing.

version.description: Format version. A reader that does not know a version must refuse the document rather than guess.

generator.description: Application that wrote the document, for example "roque-nights".

created_at.description: When the document was written, UTC.

author.description: Who made the plan. Optional and free form; no identity is implied.

site.description: Where the plan was made. The importer compares it with its own site and explains the differences.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone name, or null when the author did not know it. Never guess one: null means local times are unknown, not UTC.

night_of.description: Calendar date of the EVENING the night starts, in the site's local zone.

darkness.description: Astronomical darkness window at the author's site, or nulls when that night had none.

items.description: The blocks of the night, in any order; readers sort by start_utc.

instant.description: UTC instant. The trailing Z is required: this format has no floating local times.

target_id.description: Stable id of the target: a Messier id ("M31"), a solar system body ("jupiter", "moon") or "star:<name>". A reader that does not know the id falls back to name.

name.description: Display name of the target, for example "Andromeda".

source.description: Who put this block in the plan: the person at the eyepiece or their agent.
